text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: billing-metering-service - token_count_delta spike detected in eu-west-1 (service: emitter-bridge). Severity: P2. Start: 2026-02-12T04:13:19Z
incident-bot: Symptoms: rapid increase in token counts for a subset of customers; multiple overage flags triggered. Sample signature: emitter_id=bridge-7f, window=00:05, delta>10x baseline.
oncall-anna: I'm on it, grabbing context. What region?
sam-ops: eu-west-1. I'm switching to the live runbook.
oncall-anna: thx. @jordan-data can you pull quick compare of aggregator vs ledger counts for the last 2 hours?
jordan-data: running a quick query now, will post results in a sec.
jordan-data: query: `SELECT window, SUM(tokens_agg) AS agg, SUM(tokens_ledger) AS ledger FROM metering.events WHERE ts > now() - interval '2 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 24;`
jordan-data: results: agg > ledger by ~3-5% across windows, but there's a 40x spike for emitter_id=bridge-7f at 04:10 UTC.
mike-sre: any deploys around that time?
sam-ops: deploy bot shows a canary push to emitter-bridge at 04:08 UTC (rev: emitter-bridge@a3d2).
lucy-platform: I see a config change rolled at 04:07 that increased retry window for emitter-bridge. Could be duplication on retries.
oncall-anna: possible duplicate emission loop. If retry logic dropped idempotency key, that aligns. Jordan, can you run dedupe check on emitter-7f payload ids?
jordan-data: running: `SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE repeats>1) FROM (SELECT payload_id, COUNT(*) AS repeats FROM emitter.events WHERE emitter_id='bridge-7f' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-02-12T04:06:00Z' AND '2026-02-12T04:14:00Z' GROUP BY 1) t;`
jordan-data: hit: 12k duplicated payload_ids in that window.
oncall-anna: ok, duplication confirmed. Impact: token counts artificially inflated for customers using that emitter.
elaine-cs: any customers already notified? We have ~8 customers flagged for overage email triggers at 04:15. Some sent support tickets.
oncall-anna: hold comms for now until we know scope. We'll disable overage alerting and annotate bills.
incident-bot: action logged: disable-billing-overage-alerts (runbook step 3) executed by oncall-anna at 04:18 UTC.
mike-sre: mitigation plan: 1) rollback retry config to previous safe value (lucy), 2) stop emitter-bridge job to prevent further duplication (sam), 3) run dedupe pass and subtract duplicated tokens from aggregate counts (jordan), 4) schedule customer-facing note + credit plan (elaine).
lucy-platform: preparing rollback patch now. ETA 4 minutes.
sam-ops: issuing `kubectl scale deployment/emitter-bridge --replicas=0 -n metering` to stop emission. Executed 04:21 UTC.
jordan-data: starting dedupe/backfill job: `python -m ops.reconcile --emitter bridge-7f --start '2026-02-12T04:06' --end '2026-02-12T04:20' --mode detect_and_subtract`
jordan-data: estimate ~20m to complete on current cluster.
oncall-anna: can we do a partial quick fix to stop the largest duplicate bursts from affecting alerts?
jordan-data: yes. Pushing interim patch that tags suspect windows as "suspicious_duplicate" so billing pipeline ignores them for alerting. Patch applied 04:24 UTC.
incident-bot: update: billing-alerts suppressed for flagged windows (04:06-04:14).
elaine-cs: I'll draft a holding response for Support that says we're investigating inflated usage metrics and will follow up with an adjustment/credit if affected.
oncall-anna: good. mike, can you confirm no other emitters show same pattern?
mike-sre: scanning. `SELECT emitter_id, COUNT(distinct payload_id) / COUNT(*) AS unique_ratio FROM emitter.events WHERE ts > now() - interval '3 hours' GROUP BY emitter_id ORDER BY unique_ratio ASC LIMIT 10;`
mike-sre: only bridge-7f shows unique_ratio ~0.05 during spike window. Others normal.
sam-ops: backfill job progress: 35% complete, memory OK.
jordan-data: backfill finished at 04:45 UTC. Deduped ~1.2M duplicated token events. I've produced an adjustment delta file `adjustments/2026-02-12_bridge-7f_dedup.csv`.
oncall-anna: great. What's the customer-level impact? Jordan?
jordan-data: mapping adjustments to customers: 98% of duplicated tokens concentrated in 12 accounts, median inflation per-account = 18% for that window, 2 customers saw >120% spike.
elaine-cs: pushing credits for top 12 now. I'll prepare public incident note draft.
oncall-anna: open a private incident channel for postmortem planning. We'll need root cause: retry change removed idempotency header when requests retried. Lucy, can you confirm?
lucy-platform: confirmed: the 04:07 config accidentally omitted X-Idempotency header in the retry proxy for emitter-bridge due to a templating bug. Patch already reverted.
mike-sre: action items captured: 1) revert templating behavior + add test for idempotency header (lucy), 2) add alert that watches emitter unique_ratio < 0.2 (mike), 3) improve runbook for suppressing billing alerts (oncall-anna/elain), 4) automate dedupe pass and auto-flag (jordan).
oncall-anna: timeline for fixes? Lucy/Elaine/Jordan/Mike take ownership.
lucy-platform: patch merged to main, will schedule canary tomorrow with unit test.
mike-sre: I'll add metric and a Grafana panel. ETA 48h.
jordan-data: automating dedupe job: PR opened, ETA 72h.
elaine-cs: customer comms sent to affected accounts at 05:10 UTC. Offered pro-rated credits and explanation. One customer replied concerned about invoices. We're handling 1:1.
oncall-anna: final status for pager: mitigated - root cause identified and reverted; duplicated tokens removed and credits queued. Closing pager in 2h if no regressions.
incident-bot: Pager closed by oncall-anna at 06:25 UTC. Summary: duplicate emissions from emitter-bridge due to idempotency header omission after template change. ~1.2M duplicated tokens removed. 12 accounts impacted; credits queued.
elaine-cs: postmortem invite to relevant parties scheduled for 2026-02-15 16:00 UTC.
mike-sre: note for postmortem: attach failed template diff and CI gap.
oncall-anna: thanks all. Good catch & quick mitigation. :thumbsup:
elaine-cs: adding support thread links and customer responses to the incident doc.
jordan-data: uploading delta file to s3 `s3://redwood-incidents/1767899999/adjustments.csv`
incident-bot: incident timeline appended.
noncall-anna: closing thread here, move follow-ups to #postmortems and #billing-sre.
